# faf

<!-- badges: R-CMD-check, coverage, pkgdown (to add) -->

Technical reference for the M0159 (Fire-Adapted Forests) forest-carbon methodology under review. The package implements the methodology's equations as documented, tested R functions, and a worked example runs them on sample data.

## Overview

The Improved FOrest Management for Fire-Adapted Forests (M0159) quantifies the carbon benefit of forest restoration and fuel-reduction treatments that reduce high-severity wildfire risk, measured via remote sensing and ground-based inventories. This repository holds the methodology's reference code: the equations live as functions, so the accounting can be run and checked directly.

## Installation

```r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("Vibrant-Planet/M0159-Fire-Adapted-Forests")
```

## Usage

Two high-level functions carry the workflow:

```r
library(faf)

# Build the baseline / control area
baseline <- build_baseline(...)

# Compare the project against the baseline at verification
result <- run_comparison(baseline, ...)
```

Arguments will be documented as development continues.

## Worked example

The `worked-example` vignette runs the full accounting on sample data and renders to HTML:

```r
vignette("worked-example", package = "faf")
```

Sample data is generated by the scripts in `data-raw/`.

## Reproducibility

- Each function documents the equation it implements and the methodology version it tracks.
- Dependencies are pinned with `renv`; sample data regenerates from a fixed seed.
- Equations are tested against their closure identities.

## Status

Mid development, this repo is tracking a revised methodology submitted to Verra's VCS program. Equations and interfaces may change, and no release is tagged yet.

## Methodology

Implements M0159 (Fire-Adapted Forests). Link to the methodology document to follow.
